process.name: BizApp single-level record approval
process.documentation: Tier-3 template deployed once per installed BizApp (definition name bizapp-<kind>). The submitter's record id travels as recordId; the candidateRole manifest parameter scopes the reviewer pool. Claim and complete run through the generic engine inbox (/api/v1/workflow/engine/tasks/**) with variables decision (APPROVE | REJECT) and decidedBy; the terminal delegate writes the decision into bizapp_records.runtime and raises the record.decided webhook. This definition is deliberately outside the e-Office approval domain, so its tasks stay claimable on the generic surface.

serviceTask.name: Write decision back to the record
